title: Print with numbers
prompt: Print each item with its position in front, starting from 1: "1 bolt", "2 gear". Keep a counter that goes up each turn of the loop.
hints: The loop gives you the item; you keep the number yourself.
`var n = 1` before the loop, `n += 1` at the end of each turn.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
